changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce lender status allowed values (ACTIVE, INACTIVE) at DB level
changeSet.sql: UPDATE n_lender SET status = 'INACTIVE' WHERE status IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE')
ALTER TABLE n_lender ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_lender_status CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
